source.title: iPhone 17e Dimensional Drawings
source.coordinate_note: drawing geometry lives in a Form XObject placed by the page stream with '1 0 0 1 31.946 34.35 cm'. Add that offset to convert extracted form coordinates to page points.

datum.origin: top-left corner of the product outline, viewed from the front
datum.x: +X toward the right edge; product spans x 0 .. 71.52
datum.y: -Y down the length; product spans y 0 .. -146.71
datum.z: z 0 at the front cover-glass plane; -Z into the body. Back face at z = -7.80
datum.confirmed_by: product center reported as x 35.76 = 71.52/2 and y -73.35 = -146.71/2

edge_profile.label: PROFILE (ALL SIDES), detail B
edge_profile.pairing_note: solved from the tick marks in detail B; max residual 0.005 mm. The side is widest at |z| 2.71 and rolls 0.91 inward by |z| 3.82. Mirror in both z and the opposite side.
edge_profile.face_inset_note: the profile runs 0 -> 0.91 inward over |z| 2.71 -> 3.82, then continues to the flat face at |z| 3.90, which starts 1.15 in. 1.05 is the glass edge, a different boundary, and must not be used as the edge of the solid.

corner.type: continuous curvature (squircle), not a circular arc
corner.source: detail A, CORNER PROFILE (ALL FOUR CORNERS)
corner.plane: XY plan view; x across the width from the side edge, y along the length from the end edge
corner.dimensioned_points_note: x=0.86 is derived from the geometry; the sheet prints only six x ordinates and omits that one. Every other value is printed.
corner.polyline_note: 27 points traced off the front-view outline itself, top-left corner, running from the side edge to the end edge. All seven dimensioned points lie on it within 0.012 mm.

concentric_plan_outlines.what: drawn in every full view but never dimensioned
start of the flat face at |z| 3.90

glass.note: 1.68 is the camera-plateau height above the back glass

cutout.type: notch in the top edge of the display active area
cutout.radius_note: 2X R3.72 and 2X R0.82 dimension THIS cutout, not the product corners - both leaders were traced to the cutout's right-hand corners. The product corner is the squircle under body.corner.
cutout.corner_note: both corners are continuous-curvature blends, not arcs. Least squares over the near-circular middle gives 3.650 for the fillet and 0.859 for the tip against the printed R3.72 and R0.82. Model from the drawn corner, not the radius.

margins.note: housing edge to active area is 3.47 on the left, right and top alike

callouts: 3.31 and 3.90 repeated on the right-side view for the side button
button_cross_section.note: 3.31 is the button's width across the 7.80 thickness and 3.90 is the depth of its centre from the front face, i.e. the midplane. Measured 3.307 wide centred at z -3.900 in both side views.

sim_tray.note: 2.56 and 3.90 are called out beside the left side view. The outer drawn rectangle is 16.09 x 2.73; the dimensioned 2X 7.97 is the inner one.

recommended_connector_keepout.requirement: keepout area must be flush to the product surface and extend outward 14.0 mm

usb_c.opening_height_note: drawn, not dimensioned on the sheet

speaker_ports.note: the printed group spans are edge to edge of the outer holes. Pitch is uniform at 2.2544 across both groups, spread 0.0024.

top_edge.note: top-edge view on sheet 1 dimensions the receiver/front-mic port opening

rear_camera.frame_note: x was dimensioned in the back view. center is now product-frame; x_back keeps the printed ordinate.

front_sensors.label: FRONT SENSOR KEEPOUTS, detail E
front_sensors.confidence: values exact; the mapping of each callout to a specific edge of the keepout block was not traced

inner_zone.rule: no metal, conductive material, or magnetic material

outer_zone.rule: no magnetic or permeable material except MagSafe magnets

camera_keepout_region.shape: rectangle on the back, top-right in the product frame (top-left as drawn in the back view)
camera_keepout_region.rule: no magnetic or permeable material, full product volume including side walls

antenna_keepouts.rule: no metal or other conductive material, full product volume including side walls
antenna_keepouts.frame_note: dimensioned in sheet 2 view 2, a back-facing view. x is now product-frame; x_back keeps the printed ordinates.

design_notes.text: Do not obstruct the imaging features: front camera, rear camera, rear flash.
Do not obstruct forward facing sensors.
Relative magnetic permeability of any metal used on case: 1.05 max, per ASTM A342/A342M-14.
No magnets on rear of product except MagSafe magnets.
Case thickness on backside of product: 2.1 mm max to ensure full functionality.

unverified: front_sensors - the mapping of each detail-E callout to a specific edge of the keepout block. Detail E is a blowup at about 6.9 pt/mm and was not framed.

derivation.method: tick marks in details A and B were located in the content stream, then a linear fit mapped them to the printed ordinates. Both axes were fitted independently and agree to 0.015% (detail A) and 0.30% (detail B); worst residual 0.005 mm.
derivation.cross_check: every dimensioned corner point lies within 0.012 mm of the front-view outline, drawn elsewhere on the sheet at a different scale - so the corner table and the drawn body agree.

frames.product_frame: x 0..71.52 measured from the product's left edge viewed from the FRONT, as datum declares.
frames.identified_by: which side the button bumps sit on: action and volume are on the product's left, the side button on its right. A back-facing view has them swapped.
frames.rule: an x ordinate read in a back-facing view is 71.52 - x in the product frame. y is unaffected.
frames.affects: rear_camera, compass, camera_keepout_region and antenna_keepouts were all dimensioned in back-facing views. Their printed x values are kept below as x_back with the product-frame value alongside as x_front. Everything else in this file is already product-frame or symmetric about x 35.76.

verified.method: every value above measured against the drawn vector paths in the PDF, mapped to mm from each view's own extents
resolved_here: view frames and the back-view mirroring
